svg.aria-label: Flow of one reconciler pass: lease, discover, read journals, apply puts, apply deletes, evict, checkpoint, prune, publish usage.
svg.title: One reconciler pass
svg.text: One reconciler pass, in order
1 Lease: renew or acquire
held: renew with If-Match; else create-only, or take over
Store: put_if_match with the last tag; or create-only put,
or HEAD and If-Match once Last-Modified + ttl has passed.
Fails: books cleared, pass ends (held = false)
2 Discover proxies
list _tiering/proxies/; load the checkpoint of each new id
hot.list of the prefix; hot.get _tiering/checkpoint/<id>
(missing = 0,0,0; a read failure is reported, retried next pass)
3 Read journals
per proxy, in id order, from the last number read
list_page _journal/<id>/ after the last number, get each object.
Stops silently at a gap; a corrupt object is reported every pass
4 Apply puts (copy)
per journal object, in order: all its puts first
hot.get (whole body), then create-only cold put; AlreadyExists
counts as copied, unchecked; up to 16 at once; a gone key is skipped
5 Apply deletes
then the deletes of that same journal object
delete_cold: hot HEAD; absent: cold.delete; present and cold
content differs: cold.delete. An error stops that proxy
6 Evict (high and low water)
only if usage is above 0.8 x budget; down to 0.7 x budget
Re-read journals, drop superseded entries, take the oldest copied
entry across proxies, then hot.delete (unconditional)
7 Checkpoint
per proxy, only if it changed
HEAD, then If-Match on that tag (create-only if absent).
Not a fence: a stale holder can overwrite a newer checkpoint
8 Prune journal objects
those behind the eviction position and old enough
hot.delete when seq < evict_seq and Last-Modified + retention
(24 h in the binary) <= now; none while the cursor stays put
9 Publish usage
every pass that holds the lease, even after failures
write _tiering/usage {hot_bytes, copy_lag, time}:
HEAD; absent: create-only; else If-Match on that tag
for each proxy: steps 3-5
per proxy, 7 then 8
Sleep --reconcile-interval (5 s), then the next pass
back to step 1 (renewal happens once per pass)
